contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Silver coin. Nummus of House of Constantine; possibly Virtus Augg issue of 337-340, Reece period 17. The grey tint may indicate an unusually high proportion of silver in the metal mix. Obverse description: Bust laureate cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [--]IVLIA[--]. Reverse description: Genius left: robed figure standing left with vertically striped robe, pointed hat or helmet, transverse…
